# Implementation Plan - Semantic Organization Engine for Note-Taking MVP

Extend the Note-taking MVP with a deterministic, explainable, and real-time **Semantic Organization Feature**. When notes are created or edited, the engine infers categories, suggests related tags, and discovers semantic relationships (`related_to`, `part_of`, `synonym_of`, `extends`) to existing notes with full provenance tracking (`source: 'auto' | 'manual'`), confidence scores, and reasoning logs.

## Proposed Architecture

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[React Frontend] -->|Create/Update Note| B[Express REST API /api/notes]
    A -->|Live Semantic Preview| C[Semantic Service /api/semantic/analyze]
    B --> D[Semantic Engine]
    D -->|TF-IDF + Cosine Similarity| E[Vector Store & Token Index]
    D -->|Contextual Propagation| F[Tag & Category Inference]
    D -->|Rule-Based Relation Miner| G[Relationship Discovery]
    D -->|Explainability Generator| H[Reasoning & Confidence Engine]
    B --> I[MongoDB / In-Memory Note Repository]
    I -->|Persisted Semantic Metadata| A
    A --> J[Interactive Semantic Inspector & Graph View]
```

---

## Key Capabilities & Requirements

### 1. Explainable Auto-Classification & Relationship Engine
- **Deterministic TF-IDF & Keyword Extraction**: Tokenization, stop-word elimination, n-gram mining, and cosine/Jaccard similarity calculation.
- **Category & Topic Inference**:
  - Scores candidate categories based on weighted keyword overlap and category distribution in similar existing notes.
  - Generates clear explanation strings (e.g., *"Matched 4 keywords ['mongodb', 'express', 'node', 'api'] with Note #2 (87% similarity); inherited category 'Backend Architecture'"*).
- **Tag Suggestion with Co-occurrence**: Recommends tags found in high-similarity notes that are absent in the current note.
- **Relationship Discovery**:
  - `related_to`: High content similarity score (> 0.45).
  - `part_of`: Strong topical containment or shared cluster parent.
  - `synonym_of`: High reciprocal term overlap (> 0.85).
  - `extends`: Direct concept elaboration / follow-up keyword patterns.
  - Provides detailed reasoning metrics for each relationship link.

### 2. State & Provenance Tracking (`auto` vs `manual`)
- Data model stores provenance per field:
  - `category`: `{ value: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence: number, reasoning: string }`
  - `tags`: `Array<{ name: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence?: number, reasoning?: string }>`
  - `relationships`: `Array<{ targetNoteId: string, targetTitle: string, relationType: 'related_to' | 'part_of' | 'synonym_of' | 'extends', source: 'auto' | 'manual', similarity: number, reasoning: string }>`
  - `semanticHistory`: Log of transitions (e.g. `auto_assigned`, `accepted_by_user`, `overridden_by_user`, `tag_removed`).

### 3. User Interaction & Inspector UI
- **Live Auto-Suggestion as You Type**: Real-time semantic analysis debounced during editing.
- **1-Click Accept / Override Controls**: Users can accept suggested categories/tags/relationships with one click or edit them manually.
- **Semantic Inspector Panel**:
  - Collapsible side panel displaying confidence gauges, exact term overlap chips, and human-readable reasoning strings.
  - Raw JSON inspector modal/tab allowing judges to inspect the persisted underlying metadata.
- **Semantic Relationship Graph / Cluster Visualizer**: Visual representation of connections between notes in the workspace.
- **Demo Seed Dataset**: One-click button to load rich sample notes across multiple domains (Web Dev, Distributed Systems, ML/AI, Design) so judges can immediately observe contextual inference.

---

## File Structure & Proposed Changes

```
semantic-notes-app/
├── package.json
├── server/
│   ├── server.js               # Express server setup & API routes
│   ├── models/
│   │   └── Note.js             # Mongoose/Schema definition with Semantic Metadata
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── semanticEngine.js   # Deterministic TF-IDF, similarity & relationship logic
│   │   └── storage.js          # Unified Mongo + In-Memory fallback storage
│   └── routes/
│       └── notes.js            # Note CRUD & semantic endpoints
└── src/
    ├── App.jsx                 # Main layout, state coordinator, inspector toggle
    ├── index.css               # Modern styling with Tailwind / custom styles
    ├── main.jsx                # React root
    ├── components/
    │   ├── NoteForm.jsx        # Note creator/editor with live auto-classification chips
    │   ├── NoteList.jsx        # Note feed with semantic badges and category filters
    │   ├── NoteCard.jsx        # Card showing category, tags, relations & status
    │   ├── SemanticInspector.jsx # Side panel with reasoning, confidence, history & JSON view
    │   ├── SemanticGraph.jsx   # Visual network of note relationships
    │   └── SeedDataLoader.jsx  # 1-click test dataset loader for judges
    └── services/
        └── api.js              # Client API helper
```

---

## Verification Plan

### 1. Automated Unit & Integration Tests
- Test TF-IDF vectorization, similarity computation, and reasoning generation.
- Test endpoint `/api/notes` creation with automatic classification and relationship inference.
- Test manual override updates (`source: 'manual'`) and semantic history logging.

### 2. Manual End-to-End Verification Flow
1. **Initial State**: Launch the app with empty or seeded notes.
2. **Auto-Classification**: Create a new note titled *"Building React Custom Hooks"* with content *"Using useEffect and useMemo to optimize component rendering state"*. Verify that:
   - Category automatically infers *"Frontend Development"* or similar context.
   - Tags like `react`, `state`, `hooks` are auto-suggested with `source: 'auto'`.
   - Relationships to any existing React notes are automatically identified with explicit reasoning.
3. **User Modification**:
   - Accept some suggested tags, reject others, manually change the category to *"React Advanced"*.
   - Verify that `source` changes from `auto` to `manual`, and history records the transition.
4. **Inspectability**: Open the Semantic Inspector panel and inspect the live confidence breakdown, keyword overlap matrix, and raw JSON schema.
5. **Relationship Graph**: Switch to the Semantic Graph view to visually verify clustered relationships.

# Implementation Plan - Semantic Organization Engine for Note-Taking MVP

Extend the Note-taking MVP with a deterministic, explainable, and real-time **Semantic Organization Feature**. When notes are created or edited, the engine infers categories, suggests related tags, and discovers semantic relationships (`related_to`, `part_of`, `synonym_of`, `extends`) to existing notes with full provenance tracking (`source: 'auto' | 'manual'`), confidence scores, and reasoning logs.

## Proposed Architecture

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[React Frontend] -->|Create/Update Note| B[Express REST API /api/notes]
    A -->|Live Semantic Preview| C[Semantic Service /api/semantic/analyze]
    B --> D[Semantic Engine]
    D -->|TF-IDF + Cosine Similarity| E[Vector Store & Token Index]
    D -->|Contextual Propagation| F[Tag & Category Inference]
    D -->|Rule-Based Relation Miner| G[Relationship Discovery]
    D -->|Explainability Generator| H[Reasoning & Confidence Engine]
    B --> I[MongoDB / In-Memory Note Repository]
    I -->|Persisted Semantic Metadata| A
    A --> J[Interactive Semantic Inspector & Graph View]
```

---

## Key Capabilities & Requirements

### 1. Explainable Auto-Classification & Relationship Engine
- **Deterministic TF-IDF & Keyword Extraction**: Tokenization, stop-word elimination, n-gram mining, and cosine/Jaccard similarity calculation.
- **Category & Topic Inference**:
  - Scores candidate categories based on weighted keyword overlap and category distribution in similar existing notes.
  - Generates clear explanation strings (e.g., *"Matched 4 keywords ['mongodb', 'express', 'node', 'api'] with Note #2 (87% similarity); inherited category 'Backend Architecture'"*).
- **Tag Suggestion with Co-occurrence**: Recommends tags found in high-similarity notes that are absent in the current note.
- **Relationship Discovery**:
  - `related_to`: High content similarity score (> 0.45).
  - `part_of`: Strong topical containment or shared cluster parent.
  - `synonym_of`: High reciprocal term overlap (> 0.85).
  - `extends`: Direct concept elaboration / follow-up keyword patterns.
  - Provides detailed reasoning metrics for each relationship link.

### 2. State & Provenance Tracking (`auto` vs `manual`)
- Data model stores provenance per field:
  - `category`: `{ value: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence: number, reasoning: string }`
  - `tags`: `Array<{ name: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence?: number, reasoning?: string }>`
  - `relationships`: `Array<{ targetNoteId: string, targetTitle: string, relationType: 'related_to' | 'part_of' | 'synonym_of' | 'extends', source: 'auto' | 'manual', similarity: number, reasoning: string }>`
  - `semanticHistory`: Log of transitions (e.g. `auto_assigned`, `accepted_by_user`, `overridden_by_user`, `tag_removed`).

### 3. User Interaction & Inspector UI
- **Live Auto-Suggestion as You Type**: Real-time semantic analysis debounced during editing.
- **1-Click Accept / Override Controls**: Users can accept suggested categories/tags/relationships with one click or edit them manually.
- **Semantic Inspector Panel**:
  - Collapsible side panel displaying confidence gauges, exact term overlap chips, and human-readable reasoning strings.
  - Raw JSON inspector modal/tab allowing judges to inspect the persisted underlying metadata.
- **Semantic Relationship Graph / Cluster Visualizer**: Visual representation of connections between notes in the workspace.
- **Demo Seed Dataset**: One-click button to load rich sample notes across multiple domains (Web Dev, Distributed Systems, ML/AI, Design) so judges can immediately observe contextual inference.

---

## File Structure & Proposed Changes

```
semantic-notes-app/
├── package.json
├── server/
│   ├── server.js               # Express server setup & API routes
│   ├── models/
│   │   └── Note.js             # Mongoose/Schema definition with Semantic Metadata
│   ├── services/
│   │   ├── semanticEngine.js   # Deterministic TF-IDF, similarity & relationship logic
│   │   └── storage.js          # Unified Mongo + In-Memory fallback storage
│   └── routes/
│       └── notes.js            # Note CRUD & semantic endpoints
└── src/
    ├── App.jsx                 # Main layout, state coordinator, inspector toggle
    ├── index.css               # Modern styling with Tailwind / custom styles
    ├── main.jsx                # React root
    ├── components/
    │   ├── NoteForm.jsx        # Note creator/editor with live auto-classification chips
    │   ├── NoteList.jsx        # Note feed with semantic badges and category filters
    │   ├── NoteCard.jsx        # Card showing category, tags, relations & status
    │   ├── SemanticInspector.jsx # Side panel with reasoning, confidence, history & JSON view
    │   ├── SemanticGraph.jsx   # Visual network of note relationships
    │   └── SeedDataLoader.jsx  # 1-click test dataset loader for judges
    └── services/
        └── api.js              # Client API helper
```

---

## Verification Plan

### 1. Automated Unit & Integration Tests
- Test TF-IDF vectorization, similarity computation, and reasoning generation.
- Test endpoint `/api/notes` creation with automatic classification and relationship inference.
- Test manual override updates (`source: 'manual'`) and semantic history logging.

### 2. Manual End-to-End Verification Flow
1. **Initial State**: Launch the app with empty or seeded notes.
2. **Auto-Classification**: Create a new note titled *"Building React Custom Hooks"* with content *"Using useEffect and useMemo to optimize component rendering state"*. Verify that:

An intelligent, explainable, and real-time **Semantic Organization Engine** integrated into the React + Express + MongoDB Note-Taking MVP.

## 🌟 Key Features

### 1. Auto-Classification (Sensible Defaults)
- **Topic/Category Inference**: Automatically determines category based on TF-IDF term weights, keyword overlap with existing notes, and domain ontology.
- **Related Terms & Tags**: Suggests high-importance terms and propagates co-occurring tags from similar existing notes.
- **Conceptual Relationships**: Automatically discovers and links notes using multi-type graph semantics:
  - `related_to`: Significant topical overlap (> 35% cosine/Jaccard similarity).
  - `part_of`: Hierarchical subtopic or structural domain cluster member.
  - `synonym_of`: High reciprocal term convergence (> 75% similarity).
  - `extends`: Direct conceptual expansion and follow-up elaboration.
- **Deterministic & Explainable**: Generates human-readable reasoning strings (e.g. *"Matched 4 key terms ['react', 'state', 'hook', 'dom'] with Note #1 (84% similarity)"*).

### 2. User Editable State & Provenance Tracking
- Every auto-assigned category, tag, or relationship can be accepted, changed, or deleted with 1 click.
- Strict provenance tracking with `source: 'auto' | 'manual'`.
- Audit history logging tracks every state transition (`auto_classified` ➔ `category_manual_override`, `tag_accepted`).

### 3. Visible, Functional State & Deep Inspectability
- **Live Auto-Suggestion as You Type**: Real-time semantic analysis debounced during editing.
- **Semantic Inspector Panel**: Side drawer with confidence meters, reasoning breakdowns, tag and relationship controls, and state transition history.
- **Raw JSON Inspector**: Direct view of the persisted entity schema for immediate provability.
- **Interactive Semantic Graph**: Visual network of interconnected notes and clusters.

# Implementation Plan - Semantic Organization Engine for Note-Taking MVP

Extend the Note-taking MVP with a deterministic, explainable, and real-time **Semantic Organization Feature**. When notes are created or edited, the engine infers categories, suggests related tags, and discovers semantic relationships (`related_to`, `part_of`, `synonym_of`, `extends`) to existing notes with full provenance tracking (`source: 'auto' | 'manual'`), confidence scores, and reasoning logs.

## Proposed Architecture

```mermaid
graph TD
    A[React Frontend] -->|Create/Update Note| B[Express REST API /api/notes]
    A -->|Live Semantic Preview| C[Semantic Service /api/semantic/analyze]
    B --> D[Semantic Engine]
    D -->|TF-IDF + Cosine Similarity| E[Vector Store & Token Index]
    D -->|Contextual Propagation| F[Tag & Category Inference]
    D -->|Rule-Based Relation Miner| G[Relationship Discovery]
    D -->|Explainability Generator| H[Reasoning & Confidence Engine]
    B --> I[MongoDB / In-Memory Note Repository]
    I -->|Persisted Semantic Metadata| A
    A --> J[Interactive Semantic Inspector & Graph View]

## Key Capabilities & Requirements

### 1. Explainable Auto-Classification & Relationship Engine
- **Deterministic TF-IDF & Keyword Extraction**: Tokenization, stop-word elimination, n-gram mining, and cosine/Jaccard similarity calculation.
- **Category & Topic Inference**:

  - Generates clear explanation strings (e.g., *"Matched 4 keywords ['mongodb', 'express', 'node', 'api'] with Note #2 (87% similarity); inherited category 'Backend Architecture'"*).
- **Tag Suggestion with Co-occurrence**: Recommends tags found in high-similarity notes that are absent in the current note.
- **Relationship Discovery**:
  - `related_to`: High content similarity score (> 0.45).
  - `part_of`: Strong topical containment or shared cluster parent.
  - `synonym_of`: High reciprocal term overlap (> 0.85).
  - `extends`: Direct concept elaboration / follow-up keyword patterns.
  - Provides detailed reasoning metrics for each relationship link.

### 2. State & Provenance Tracking (`auto` vs `manual`)

  - `category`: `{ value: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence: number, reasoning: string }`
  - `tags`: `Array<{ name: string, source: 'auto' | 'manual', confidence?: number, reasoning?: string }>`
